newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian girl, four, killed in Vlore-state TV.
newsitem.headline: Albanian girl, four, killed in Vlore-state TV.

text.p: A four-year-old girl was killed by gunfire on Tuesday in the riot-torn southern Albanian port of Vlore while she was playing outside her home, state television reported.
Its report, which could not be independently confirmed, named the girl as Shqiponja Rrapi. Three other children in the Adriatic port were wounded by explosives, television said.
Albania's parliament declared a nationwide state of emergency on Sunday after violent unrest in Vlore and other southern towns in which protesters raided police and army weapons depots.
President Sali Berisha has blamed the unrest, which stemmed from popular anger over loss of savings in dubious pyramid investment schemes, on former communists and foreign espionage services.
"A four-year-old girl was killed because of shooting by terrorist groups," the television report said. "She was playing in the courtyard of her house".

Security forces with orders to shoot armed protesters on sight have been moving south from Tirana to restore order but the authorities said on Tuesday that Vlore and the coastal town of Sarande remained out of their control.
